fields.summary: Import using inbound references (-i) throws status 403 error

comments.body: Esmé Cowles It loos like the error is related to https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2483 and your PR https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/93 should fix it, right?
Situ, Longshou, Yes, I think this is the same problem that Jim Coble raised in FCREPO-2483
Looks like this was not resolved by https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/93
Situ, Longshou: are you in a position to test this PR? https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/99

Esmé Cowles I am testing it now but the export process seems taking much longer time. But it could be done finally. It seems like its looping some records repeatedly and I see lots messages like:
INFO 11:15:05.868 (Exporter) Exporting binary: http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/67/fb/74/b0/67fb74b0-87f6-4c58-a899-4456da6328b0/internal
INFO 11:15:05.870 (Exporter) Exported http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/67/fb/74/b0/67fb74b0-87f6-4c58-a899-4456da6328b0/internal to /Users/lsitu/Documents/Fedora_Import_Export/data_3b_v48_/fcrepo/rest/67/fb/74/b0/67fb74b0-87f6-4c58-a899-4456da6328b0/internal.binary
INFO 11:15:05.870 (Exporter) Already exported http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/67/fb/74/b0/67fb74b0-87f6-4c58-a899-4456da6328b0/internal/fcr:metadata
INFO 11:15:05.872 (Exporter) Already exported http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest/67/fb/74/b0/67fb74b0-87f6-4c58-a899-4456da6328b0
I
Andrew Woods The 403 error is gone for import but just a little concern regarding the performance for the export process. See #comment-55738.

Andrew Woods I added one comment for PR https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/99 to address the slow performance I see in #comment-55738 above. I think adding a global [inboundMembers] set/list to keep track of the inbound resources that are handled and check for existence before adding any such resources to the inboundMembers for processing could avoid some repeated import works. Just a little concern regarding those "Already exported" resources and I won't want to block the merging process. And I am fine with either way to deal with it. Could you take over from there? Thanks.
Situ, Longshou: do you have a link to your additional commit?
Andrew Woods Here is the link to the line comment in the PR https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/99#discussion_r118767110.
I've updated https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/99 to handle binary descriptions and avoid duplicate exports.

I've opened a new PR where I'm including the test results showing the build failure in their own commit, and then I'll add the functional updates that resolve the binary description issue in a third commit: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/102
